column1: Sonny, we got an anonymous tip that a drug deal is going down at Bert's Park. We've got to get over there.
column2: Sonny，我們收到匿名線報，伯特公園正在進行毒品交易。我們得趕快過去。

column1: Too bad you weren't able to secure the No Bail Warrant, Sonny. That really would have been a feather in your cap. Oh, well. Since it was your first action since joining the unit, I don't think Morgan will come down too hard on you. Better luck next time.
column2: 可惜你沒能拿到不得交保令，Sonny。那本來會是你的漂亮成績。算了，畢竟這是你加入小組後的第一次任務，我想 Morgan 不會對你太嚴厲。下次加油。

column1: Alright, Sonny. You got the warrant. Good job! Boy, this'll be a feather in your cap.
column2: 好，Sonny。你拿到令狀了。做得好！這下可要記你一功。

column1: This isn't Space Quest IV, Bonds. You can only go down the drain professionally in this game.
column2: 這不是《太空任務 IV》，Bonds。在這款遊戲裡，只有你的職涯會一路下水溝。

column1: It's a storm drain. It rarely rains in this part of California, but in case it does, the LPD is ready.
column2: 這是雨水排水溝。加州這一帶很少下雨，但萬一真的下了，Lytton 警察局已做好準備。

column1: Watch it, Sonny. I'll cite you for copping a feel...or is that feeling a cop?
column2: 小心點，Sonny。我可以開單告你亂摸……還是說，你是在摸警察？

column1: The door opens automatically. Just walk up to it.
column2: 門會自動打開，直接走過去就好。

column1: This is the entrance to the police station.
column2: 這是警察局入口。

column1: What, did you think there was a key hidden under it?
column2: 怎麼，你以為鑰匙藏在下面嗎？

column1: It's the mat that triggers the automatic sliding doors.
column2: 是這張墊子觸發自動滑門。

column1: The pole doesn't budge. Good thing, too, since it helps hold up the building.
column2: 柱子紋風不動。這樣正好，畢竟它還要支撐整棟建築。

column1: It's a support pole.
column2: 這是支撐柱。

column1: You can't do that -- at least not now!
column2: 你不能那樣做——至少現在不行！

column1: Hey, Sonny, I have some paperwork to take care of. Why don't you go to the Blue Room and tell Jack the good news? That creep won't be on the streets for a long time!
column2: 嘿，Sonny，我還有些文書工作要處理。你去藍房告訴傑克這個好消息吧？那個人渣很久都別想在街上逍遙了！

column1: Okay, sounds good. I'll head on over there. See you later, Laura.
column2: 好，沒問題。我這就過去。回頭見，Laura。

column1: You haven't been on foot patrol for years. Use a car!
column2: 你已經好幾年沒徒步巡邏了。開車吧！

column1: Only uniformed officers can use the patrol car, Bonds.
column2: Bonds，只有穿制服的警員才能使用巡邏車。

column1: That's your departmental issue patrol car.
column2: 那是警局配發給你的巡邏車。

column1: You'll need the undercover car's keys before you can drive it.
column2: 你得先拿到便衣車的鑰匙才能開它。

column1: This vehicle belongs to the Narcotics Unit. It was confiscated in a large drug bust upstate and issued to the department through a program which distributes siezed assets to local law enforcement agencies.
column2: 這輛車屬於緝毒組。它是在州外的大型掃毒行動中查扣的，之後透過分配沒收資產給地方執法機關的計畫，配發給本局使用。

column1: Yep, solid wall.
column2: 沒錯，是一面實心牆。

column1: This is the Lytton Police station.
column2: 這是 Lytton 警察局。

column1: You're not that tall, Bonds.
column2: Bonds，你沒那麼高。

column1: It's an air conditioning vent. Budgetary constraints have forced a cutback in the use of air conditioning, except in the hottest weather.
column2: 這是冷氣通風口。受限於預算，除非天氣熱到受不了，否則冷氣都得少開。

column1: Yep, solid hallway.
column2: 沒錯，是一條實心走廊。

column1: This hallway leads left to the parking garage and right to the main hallway.
column2: 這條走廊左通停車場，右通主走廊。

column1: A bulletin board displaying general notices and announcements. There's nothing new today.
column2: 這是一面張貼一般通知與公告的佈告欄。今天沒有新消息。

column1: You're more concerned with advancement at work and improving your social life than you are in performing volunteer work.
column2: 比起做志工，你更在意工作升遷和改善社交生活。

column1: A flyer looking for volunteers for the Police Athletic League.
column2: 這是警察體育聯盟招募志工的傳單。

column1: Don't take it down, it's an antique!
column2: 別把它撕下來，這可是古董！

column1: A notice urging all Department personnel to sell their share of tickets to the annual Policeman's Ball.
column2: 這張通知鼓勵全體警局人員推銷年度警察舞會的票。

column1: This particular notice is two years old. The Policeman's Ball isn't held here anymore; there wasn't enough community support.
column2: 這張通知已經兩年了。警察舞會現在不在這裡舉辦，因為社區支持不夠。

column1: Don't bother. Whoever rear-ended the Jaguar will no doubt remove this notice as soon as possible.
column2: 別費事了。那個撞上美洲豹車尾的人，肯定會盡快把這張通知拿掉。

column1: That's okay, there are nicer posters of La Boheme available by mail-order.
column2: 沒關係，郵購目錄裡有更好看的《波希米亞人》海報。

column1: You'll pass.
column2: 你會通過的。

column1: Someone lost a male Tabby in Cotton Cove.
column2: 有人在棉花灣弄丟了一隻公虎斑貓。

column1: You don't hold out much hope. Lost domesticated pets rarely survive long on their own.
column2: 你不抱太大希望。走失的家養寵物很少能獨自在外面活太久。
